title_zh: 中国共产党拉萨市第十一届委员会第一次全体会议举行 达娃次仁主持
title_en: First Plenary Session of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Party Committee Held, Chaired by Dawaciren
summary_zh: 10月22日下午，中国共产党拉萨市第十一届委员会第一次全体会议举行，达娃次仁主持会议，选举产生新一届市委常务委员会委员。
summary_en: On the afternoon of Oct 22, the first plenary session of the 11th Lhasa Municipal Committee of the CPC was held. Chaired by Dawaciren, it elected the new Standing Committee members.
